== Summary ==
The [[2008 US East Nationals]] final in progress in the Origins play hall (left, [[Justin Desai]] and [[Jan Westergard]]), next to the Players Committee banner "Come back to the game you love – Join the community @ www.swccgpc.com and visit our tournament events".

* '''Source:''' [https://www.flickr.com/photos/28182354@N06/2627540345/ "finalsbanner"], flickr, posted by brad227lex on 1 July 2008. flickr caption: "on the right: the banner.  the left: east nationals final duel."
* '''Original image:''' https://live.staticflickr.com/3104/2627540345_536ef85ab0_o.jpg (3264×2448, Kodak EasyShare M883)
* '''Date:''' 28 June 2008 (camera time 20:27)
* '''Photographer:''' [[Brad Eier]] (flickr user ''brad227lex''), chairperson of the [[2008 US East Nationals]]. The account is his: its bye-card photo is captioned "this is the card i got at yavin" and the card bears the handwritten name Brad Eier (see [[:File:2008 Worlds Day 2 bye card Yavin IV Regional Brad Eier.jpg]]), and the sealed-deck caption says "we ran" the side event.
* '''Licence:''' flickr lists the photo as All Rights Reserved. Uploaded as a record of the tournament with the wiki owner's approval; credit the photographer and link the flickr page when reusing.
* '''Identification:''' flickr caption; the finalists wear the same clothes as in the captioned final photo.
